evidence.locator: PDF p.2; Section 3 Hierarchical temporal aggregation, numerical definitions
evidence.quote: Hierarchical temporal aggregation. To support multi- scale interpretation while controlling context length, the As- sistant block forms two groups of aggregates over non- overlapping windows W ∈{6h, 1d}: T W = 1 |W| X t∈W Tt, T max W = max t∈W Tt, T min W = min t∈W Tt, RHW = 1 |W| X t∈W RHt, U W = 1 |W| X t∈W Ut, PW = X t∈W Pt. Wind direction is averaged on the circle, ¯θW = atan2 � 1 |W| X t∈W sin θt, 1 |W| X t∈W cos θt  [◦], and is stored for 6-hour windows; for daily windows we omit ¯θ1d to avoid misleading circular averages. Dew point and visibility are aggregated as means; winds are summarized by mean and (optionally) maxima. Thus each 6-hour record contains { T, T max, T min, RH, U, ¯θ, P }; each daily record mirrors this set except for wind direction.

reviews.rationale: K.2 directly instantiates a reusable instruction template: inspect a collection, rank relevant cases, retain question/answer/metadata, then solve the target. Time/location/event types are metadata for relevance, with no specialised numerical temporal similarity or warning decision boundary. GH reflects the concrete prompt-level procedure, not a hypothetical generalisation of the warning task.
reviews.supporting_quote: Select at most six cases. Preserve each selected case’s question, reference answer, and event metadata so that its analogy remains interpretable.

reviews.rationale: K.2 hides a reference answer, rehearses a task, reveals reference feedback, and distils short procedures while excluding case-specific facts. The update output is generic skill guidance and the prompt uses task placeholders rather than a warning-specific prediction, action, or loss. GH is consistent with the generic experience update accepted for TimeClaw.
reviews.supporting_quote: Add or revise only short, actionable guidance that can improve future tasks of the same kind. Keep one reusable procedure per item.

reviews.rationale: The instantiated analyst outputs are investment signals, momentum/CVaR and stock selection; the sole manager forms sequential trading actions and portfolio weights. This particular aggregation contract is financially specialised. Unlike SIREN K.2, the source does not define this record as a task-placeholder coordination template independently of those outputs.

shared_boundary_rule: Classify the implemented module contract. Domain-labelled input metadata alone does not imply TSK; task-required outputs/actions/objectives do. Distinct numerical temporal transformations may remain GTS even when their enclosing pipeline has task-specific context-selection rules.
